resources.string: Uses reliable GPS and filters jumps. If GPS is lost, reports no valid fix to iPhone and keeps sending available vehicle speed; iOS decides how to locate. Resumes after three reliable GPS updates. Off uses the default behavior. Applies at the next connection.

Excludes network and fused location. Drift protection remains controlled separately; turn it off to send unfiltered GPS positions. Reports no fix when GPS is lost or stale. Applies at the next connection.
